title: 故宫的雪，等了六百年｜北京 Forbidden City in Snow (普通话·京味)
description:
一下雪，北京就变成了北平，故宫就变成了紫禁城。六百年前永乐皇帝把它建成，二十四位皇帝在这儿看过雪。红墙、金瓦、白雪，压着六百年的安静。

When it snows, Beijing becomes old Beiping and the Forbidden City becomes the Purple Forbidden City again. Completed in 1420 under the Yongle Emperor, it was home to 24 emperors across roughly 600 years — red walls, golden tiles, and snow.

音频语言 / Audio: 普通话·京味 (Standard Mandarin with a Beijing flavour in the script — not native 北京话 audio).
